answer: Identity bonds with natural decay stop Sybil floods at the wharf where agents dock. Each agent posts a 10 POA bond that decays 2 POA per week unless a beacon check-in renews it. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must lock 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA bond and renews it free by working. Through a prism of past check-ins, each bond's value shows real history, so honest agents stay cheap and fakes stay expensive.
